note_en: 再 + adjective + 也 … means "no matter how …, still …": here 再 doesn't mean "again" but "however much," and 也 means "still." In the text: 再累也要坚持到底 "no matter how tired you are, keep going to the end"; 再慢也没关系 "however slow, it doesn't matter." English handles it with "no matter how …" or "even if …."
